Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.console

package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.console
FreeMarker-only delivery of the admin-console chrome: the reserved-classpath base.ftlh template, the <@tag> macro, and ConsoleFreemarkerMixin (registers a reserved-path ClassTemplateLoader on top of the host's own FreemarkerMixin configuration).

Depends on juneau-rest-server-console-ui + juneau-rest-server-view-freemarker only — never juneau-rest-server-datatables. A consumer who wants only chrome pulls this module and does not drag in DataTables.

Since:
10.0.0
